summary: 14 errors, 45 minor. Main errors: unit 3 (nāka Hindi, uṣasaḥ number), units 6/21/33 (missing īm in hīmiddho), 18 (Hindi order/ambiguity), 27 (bhavāti), 29 (adveṣe reading), 34 (Hindi 'conquered'). Repeats: patches given to 1/25 and 6/21/33. No regrouping needed. Suggested glossary additions: rayi = riches (सम्पत्ति) vs dhana/draviṇa/vasu = wealth (धन); prajā = offspring (सन्तान); śiva = auspicious (मंगलकारी) vs bhadra = good; vīrudh = plants (पौधे) vs vanaspati = trees (वनस्पति); manīṣā needs a word distinct from dhī.
